items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: That was Harry Truman’s, by the way, that was his favorite song.

ctx.x: That song was played three times in the Benny Goodman movie. I love that song. That was written by my dear friend Eubie Blake. He used to come to see me every birthday he had, for years and years my dear friend. He was a very close friend of mine, Eubie Blake. And when it was his birthday he came to see me, when he was like 98 years old, 99, I think he lived to about 101. And I always played “Memories of You” for him, it actually brought tears to my eyes when I played it for this man who was sitting in the…
Yeah. Makes for a good political song.
